replay_disclaimer: Replay numbers are not physical microphone, speaker, network, screen-capture, or UI-startup measurements.

replay_scope.ambient_armed_cpu: real pinned worker/model paths when replay env vars are set; otherwise reported as external-model-assets-required
replay_scope.bootstrap_ipc: JSON encode/decode replay; excludes WebView transport and paint
replay_scope.desktop_snapshot_warm: serialized accessibility-tree replay; excludes physical screen capture and input
replay_scope.startup_native_setup: serialized native-state replay; excludes window-system and physical device probes
replay_scope.stt_accuracy: ten CC0 Common Voice 11 utterances transcribed by each real configured engine when replay env vars are set; no hard WER threshold
replay_scope.stt_endpoint: real pinned Silero v5 recurrent-state inference plus one Smart Turn v3.2 consultation when replay env vars are set
replay_scope.stt_partial_lag_ms: paced 20 ms CC0 corpus replay comparing observed partial emit wall-time with the worker-reported decoder audio boundary when replay env vars are set
replay_scope.tts_ack_first_audio_ms: warmup-cached acknowledgement phrase read from the 64 MiB LRU disk cache and handed to a bounded in-memory PCM sink; excludes synthesis and physical device startup
replay_scope.tts_first_audio_ms: three-clause fake-engine turn through a one-clause prebuffer and bounded in-memory PCM sink; excludes physical device startup
